evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper headers and implementation to attach logging connections to contexts and support per-connection log levels.
rationale: Prevents breaking API churn by introducing per-context logging connections before downstream code depends on the existing global routing. As the author notes, 'the main purpose is to change the API now, before more code depends on it: #30342 builds on this to give each context's connection only that context's entries'.
